capabilities: Open the Knowii community in a dockable pane or main tab
Notify about new messages, mentions, replies, posts and events
Save posts and chat threads as notes in the vault
Post a question to a Knowii space from a selection or note
Search, mark read and archive items in the what's-new list
extras: On phones and tablets the pane only shows an inbox of new items; the community itself opens in the browser. Optionally sharing the session across devices stores it in plain text in data.json, which the README flags as a security trade-off.
problem: Knowii members have to leave Obsidian and use a browser to follow community discussions, messages, notifications and events.

relations.evidence: Take part in the Knowii community without leaving your vault.

summary: Knowii community client that embeds the Knowii feed, spaces, direct messages, notifications and events in a pane inside Obsidian.
